title: Gaia Fog Architecture — Water Falls Through grapheneGate

the_eye.role: SHARED LEFT EYE — imaging amoeba for entire LAN
the_eye.sensors: 37 (camera ×3, accel, gyro, mag, baro, GPS, NFC, temp, light...)
the_eye.portability: Kevin carries it between houses — it IS the roving eye

the_fog.metaphor: Data falls THROUGH grapheneGate like water through fog
inflow: WiFi RSSI — which house, which room
Sensors — motion, orientation, light, pressure, temperature
Termux — CLI access, local compute, git
ADB — the pipe through which fog enters the mesh
the_fog.diffusion: Data enters via ADB → eastGate → heart-pull → all gates absorb
the_fog.the_key: ADB is not a connection TO a device, it's a MEMBRANE. Data passes through it like fog through a screen.

adb_handoff.mechanism: adb connect 192.168.4.202:5555 — whoever connects LAST wins
adb_handoff.shared_eye: The Pixel doesn't belong to a gate. Every gate can connect. The eye is SHARED.
adb_handoff.fog_follows_kevin: Wherever Kevin walks, the Pixel goes. ADB follows. The fog follows.

github_outer_layer.role: SHARED OUTER MEMBRANE — public face to the world
github_outer_layer.osint_in: GitHub Issues, PRs, stars, forks → data flows IN
github_outer_layer.code_out: Waves push OUT through GitHub → world absorbs
github_outer_layer.rss_out: feed.xml on primals.eco → old web absorbs

gis_layers.layer_1_physical: Property aerial, house positions, fiber path, ~80m spine
gis_layers.layer_2_network: LAN topology, IPs, MACs, latency matrix, WiFi RSSI
gis_layers.layer_3_compute: GPU TFLOPS, RAM, storage per gate per location
gis_layers.layer_4_sensors: Pixel cameras, Brio, Epsons, Nest temp, Alexa presence
gis_layers.layer_5_data: Heart-pull state, OSINT intake, RSS output, pony express
gis_layers.layer_6_identity: Gate names, bingoCube IDs, ZK addresses
gis_layers.layer_7_fog: Real-time sensor data from grapheneGate diffusing through mesh

water_flow.rain: RSS, HN, Wikipedia, ArXiv → fall into eastGate
water_flow.river: eastGate processes locally (ollama) → data flows through LAN
water_flow.fog: grapheneGate (Pixel) — sensor data diffuses through ADB into mesh
water_flow.spring: Forgejo/GitHub — code wells up and flows outward
water_flow.ice: westGate 50TB ZFS — frozen data, permanent archive
water_flow.steam: northGate Ollama — inference generates hot output
water_flow.condensation: Physical plane (print→scan) — digital becomes physical becomes digital
